svg.title: BaseNetwork architecture diagram
svg.desc: A paper-style architecture diagram of the BaseNetwork CNN, showing five convolutional blocks with batch norm and SiLU activations, followed by flatten and linear layers, with spatial dimensions annotating each stage.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What format does the input image need to be in for BaseNetwork?')
sendPrompt('What does stride=2 do in a convolution?')
sendPrompt('Why use a second conv without striding here?')
sendPrompt('What does doubling channels here do for the model?')
sendPrompt('Why keep the same number of channels here?')
sendPrompt('What is the spatial size after this final strided conv?')
sendPrompt('What size is the vector after flattening?')
sendPrompt('What is output_dim set to for the SimCLR encoder?')
